head: # AGENT-LANG `v1` — symbolic inter-agent communication
| Field | Value |
| **ID** | **AGENT-LANG-001-SPEC** |
| **Status** | **ACTIVE** |
| **Normative for** | HANDOFF · agent orders · queue `note` · paste blocks |
| **Parent** | [`plan_mcp_agent_lang_program_v1.md`](plan_mcp_agent_lang_program_v1.md) |

## Why
Agents burn tokens on **paths, prose, and re-reads**. AGENT-LANG compresses **status, routing, refs, and build loops** into a shared alphabet.
## 1. Pipeline AUTH line
```text
AUTH: MAT★ ⇢ APS★ ⇢ SNAP★ ⇢ WRK○ ⇢ ATL○ ⇢ RT○
| Sym | Meaning |
| `★` | Closed / witness green |
| `○` | Open |
| `○→★` | Closed this session |
| `⇢` | Flow |
| `↺` | Loop / retry |
## 2. Slice & route
| Sym | Example | Meaning |
| `⟨ID⟩` | `⟨APS-MAT-003⟩` | Queue / program row |
| `@agent` | `@coder-mcp` | Role |
| `ΔWF→@agent` | `ΔWF→@coder G2S-2` | Route next |
| `⏸` | `⏸ WH-TRACK-B` | Paused — non-blocking |
| `⚡P0` | `⚡P0 plain P0 gate` | Do first |
## 3. Status dimensions (max 3 emoji per section)
| Sym | Use |
| 🟢 | Green witness / gate pass |
| 🟡 | Qualified / pass with notes |
| 🔴 | Blocked |
| 🧊 | Explicit defer |
| 🧩 | Dependency |
| 🔗 | Cross-ref only |
| 💬 | Human / operator gate |
